reports.title: An early report promised major S26 Ultra improvements
reports.summary: SamMobile reported a leak claiming Samsung's next Ultra would bring more substantial changes than its recent predecessors.

reports.title: S26 Pro and Edge models were tipped for a battery change
reports.summary: A report said the Galaxy S26 Pro and S26 Edge could receive different battery capacities, while charging details remained unknown.

reports.title: The base S26 camera leak suggested limited upgrades
reports.summary: A camera leak for the base Galaxy S26 was reported as disappointing to those expecting a major sensor upgrade.

reports.title: A rumor promised camera and battery upgrades across the lineup
reports.summary: A separate, explicitly skeptical rumor claimed all Galaxy S26 phones could receive meaningful camera, battery and display improvements.

reports.title: One UI 8.5 builds exposed the S26 family design
reports.summary: Reports said Samsung's own leaked software builds showed the S26, S26+ and S26 Ultra designs, including a changed camera treatment.
